workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
I've checked Elena Soto and David Okafor's calendars against all the proposed time slots. Unfortunately, NONE of the slots work for all four partners:

- Monday 9:00-10:00: Elena busy 9-10 (Contract review + Recruiting call), David busy 9-10 (Quarterly planning + Recruiting call)
- Tuesday 13:00-14:00: Elena busy 13-14 (Quarterly planning + Contract review), David busy 13-14 (Client call + Busy)
- Tuesday 16:30-17:00: Elena busy 16:30-17 (Hiring panel), David busy 16:30-17 (Travel)
- Wednesday 15:00-16:00: Elena free 15-15:30 only, David busy entire 15-16 (Partner lunch + Busy)
- Thursday 10:00-10:30: Elena busy 10-10:30 (Hiring panel), David is free
- Friday 11:00-12:00: Elena busy 11-12 (Client dinner prep + 1:1), David busy 11-12 (Training + Litigation strategy)

There appears to be no overlap when all four partners are free. Could you double-check Priya and Marcus's calendars? Or should we consider reporting this as infeasible?
